result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY audit of Snapshot → World Prompt → Commit Request revision binding for G3-001 correction. Live starter snapshot fixture world_revision=3. Exported complete path still binds expected_world_revision=0 on world_prompt.target, commit_request, and complete_receipt. Schema allows minimum 0 (valid JSON) but optimistic-concurrency semantics require binding to live snapshot.world_revision when a snapshot is loaded. Defect is confirmed for C1_EXECUTOR_PATCH; no contract edits required.

invariant.builder_default_rule: CompanionWorldPromptBuilder.expected_world_revision default 0 and CompanionModule._ensure_logic_state configure_context(expected_world_revision:0) MUST NEVER override live snapshot context once a snapshot is loaded.

defects_found.title: Complete handoff binds expected_world_revision=0 while live snapshot is 3
defects_found.detail: Codex adversarial challenge confirmed. g3_complete_receipt.json carries expected_world_revision=0 and nested commit_request.expected_world_revision=0 while source_snapshot_id matches valid_snapshot_desktop_bridge (world_revision=3).

defects_found.title: World prompt export carries target.expected_world_revision=0
defects_found.detail: world_prompt_from_build.json target.expected_world_revision is 0. Elevation from AGM build_proposal uses CompanionWorldPromptBuilder context; AGM build_proposals do not carry revision, so builder context is sole source.

defects_found.title: Commit request handoff stub export expected_world_revision=0
defects_found.detail: commit_request_handoff_stub.json expected_world_revision is 0, violating equality with live snapshot world_revision=3.

defects_found.title: CompanionModule path never rebinds builder revision from live snapshot
defects_found.detail: Root cause chain: (1) CompanionModule._ensure_logic_state configures CompanionWorldPromptBuilder with expected_world_revision:0. (2) g3_onboarding_slice.load_world_state_snapshot sets companion live snapshot_id only on CompanionModule path; configure_context with snapshot world_revision runs only when _wp_builder != null (fallback presenter path). (3) When _use_companion_module is true, builder stays at default 0. (4) PromptPipeline.confirm prefers target.expected_world_revision when present, overriding live rev passed from ExecutorModule.confirm_prompt. (5) build_complete_receipt prefers commit_request.expected_world_revision over _snapshot.world_revision.

defects_found.title: No smoke contrast asserting revision equality / 0-leak rejection
defects_found.detail: g3_e2e_smoke.gd checks world_revision_advanced on cancel but does not assert commit_request.expected_world_revision == live snapshot world_revision, nor fail when 0 leaks while snapshot is 3.

required_fixes.action: After load_world_state_snapshot, always rebind builder revision from live snapshot.world_revision on BOTH companion-module and fallback paths. Prefer CompanionModule API if available; else configure_context on builder. Never leave expected_world_revision at builder default 0 when snapshot is present.

If CompanionModule is the only path that owns the builder, expose set_live_snapshot / configure from snapshot so expected_world_revision is taken from snapshot.world_revision. Default 0 remains only as cold-start placeholder when no snapshot is loaded.

required_fixes.scope: game/scripts/modules/executor/prompt_pipeline.gd and/or confirm path in g3_onboarding_slice / executor_module
required_fixes.action: When a live snapshot revision is known, do not let a stale target.expected_world_revision=0 override it. Preferred: rebind world_prompt.target.expected_world_revision to live snapshot before submit/confirm; commit_request must copy that bound value.

complete_receipt.expected_world_revision must equal live_snapshot.world_revision and commit_request.expected_world_revision after binding. Do not prefer a stale 0 from commit_request when snapshot is loaded.
After fix, re-export world_prompt_from_build.json, commit_request_handoff_stub.json, g3_complete_receipt.json with expected_world_revision=3 (matching fixture).
Add positive revision-equality assertion and negative contrast (fail if 0 leaks while snapshot is 3). See result.contrast_test_spec.
